Three modern rose options to shortlist in India:

Ahmed Al Maghribi Ignite Rose — ₹5,200. A richer, contemporary rose suited to evening wear; closest to a premium Middle-Eastern style.

Bashashat Amor En Rose — ₹4,275. A more polished, feminine rose profile; good if you want something elegant rather than oud-heavy.

Nykaa Rose Quartz — ₹989. Fresh floral-musk interpretation, lighter and easier for everyday/office use.

For a more luxurious, modern rose, consider Ignite Rose; for easy daily wear, Rose Quartz is the simpler option. Prices can change, so verify the seller and current price before ordering.
